watch.summary: The creator compares an opponent's sleek hiding spot to his own hilariously oversized, bulging prop model.

beats.what: Creator wonders how the opponent fits so flat against the wall.
He notes the opponent chose a normal-sized prop.
He questions why he chose a massive prop that stuck out.
Camera cuts to a side view showing his prop bulging wildly out of the wall frame.
Creator laughs describing how huge his character's backside was.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: My butt was the size of this guy's whole entire body.
watch.why: The comedy stems from the visual contrast between the opponent's stealthy hiding spot and the streamer's absurdly thick prop bulging out of the wall. His self-deprecating commentary highlights how terrible his hiding strategy was.
